nom: Paula's Choice Skin Perfecting 25% AHA + 2% BHA Exfoliant Peeling

avis.texte: Here is a picture of what I use for my face which is both oily and dry. It has been hard finding the right face products for my skin. A lot of times it would clog my large pores, or I would have white heads along with dry/ red blotchy skin. Then I researched some of Paula’s Choice products. I picked out what I thought fit my type of skin. After some adjusting my skin has been the best it has ever been. I don’t have big blackheads, white heads, dry skin, or red blotches. And it feels great. In the morning I use the face wash, eye cream, and the daily hydrating fluid lotion. At night I use the face wash, the toner (make sure you let your face completely dry afterwards before moving on), I use 3 drops of the boost (let that dry), then I put on the night oil free moisturizer. Every Tuesday night I use the exfoliate instead of the toner. You let it dry completely. It takes about 15 minutes. I usually don’t put anything on after using the exfoliate because I am too tired to wait for it to dry. It works for me. Then about once a month or every two weeks on a Friday night, after using the toner, I use exfoliate rinse off treatment. Afterwards I finish with the boost and night moisturizer.

My 43 year old skin is in full-on revolt. After 20 years of mostly problem-free skin, all of a sudden I'm experiencing major hormone-related changes -- lots of blemishes, excess oiliness and dehydration. Every inch of my face is doing something different, so it's been challenging to find the right products. I've tried a lot of these type of peeling rinse off products, but this was the first time I've tried Paula's Choice. I've been using it once a week for a month and am really happy with the results. I experienced a bit of discomfort when I initially applied it--a tingly almost burning sensation--but that faded after a couple of minutes. The first time I used it, after I rinsed it off and applied toner, serums and moisturizer I wasn't super impressed. My skin looked mildly irritated but that was it. Within 24 hours my skin (to me) was more glowy and smooth, and 48 hours after use it was noticeably glowy and smooth -- so much that my husband did a triple-take! Other benefits I've noticed: it's helped treat and minimize blemishes rapidly, helped even my skin tone and texture noticeably, and my skin looks and feels much more comfortable. All four times I've used it, the best results have come 48 hours later (although my skin throughout the entire week is much improved!) Because it's slightly irritating, I'll always be cautious about how much I use it, and after six weeks of use I'll probably take a break from it for a couple of weeks, but I will definitely be purchasing this ag
I don’t get the hype?? Everyone just raves over these PC products. But. I didn’t see any improvement or real change in my skin at all. (I used it for 3 weeks. 3x a week… normal skin… 49 yrs old)

I usually use The Ordinary peel but wanted to try something different. I use as directed but I see no difference with results. This is a much thicker product so it won’t last as long and I don’t like the smell. Considering the price I won’t order again.

Second time purchasing this product. It keeps my skin soft and smooth. It tingles a little and smells a little funny, but it works well and is definitely tolerable for 10 minutes as the package recommends. I use it about once a week, and it lasts a long time using a thin coating.
One of the best products you can have in your skin care routine, I use it every other week. Great results!
Love, Love, Love this! Goes on smooth. Feels great on my face. Highly recommend!
I only use this brand, color was pretty, washed off with warm water, left my skin super soft and smooth without the caked on feeling or stiffness
I bought this after seeing it recommended on social media. It has not disappointed! My skin feels fantastic and this product has fitted in to my skin care routine and will be staying.
I use this mask every few weeks and I actually love it. Love the colour of the mask and it gives me a good skin flush, face feels clean and clear morning after using.
I would have given five stars but product came in a bag and very surprised the tube was not wrapped in bubble wrap or some form of protection--it arrived safely but it could have been another story.

This was delivered to me like this in broken form I had kept it away safely now it’s completely open from back !! Please do the needful . I never had such experience with Paula’s choice so far this is the first

avis.titre: It did left my skin soft.
avis.texte: This is a small tube. The gel is purple, easy to distribute on the face because is more liquid. After I put it on, my face did burn a little, not too much but definitely I felt it during the 10 minutes. I washed off with warm water. No redness or burn after. My skin did felt smoother and soft. It does have a pretty light but noticeable scent... I didn’t like it at all. Just because I have sensitive skin and this felt burning on me, I will keep using it but not as often.
This makes my skin so soft and glowy! The best is the day after using it. It’s so easy too.. just slap it on, wait 10 minutes, and rinse it off.

This product didn't work (for me) as I had hoped. It's pricey, for one and is only 1 fluid ounce. After using as directed, my skin still felt bumpy and gritty as if I never exfoliated it. I was also thinking it would've been a bigger tube considering the price.
Today is 12 Aug 2023. I just received the aha and bha mask and the expiry date showed 06/01/2023, so it is already expired!!!!
